title: Rotor Vibration Fixture
text:
Chapter 1 Rotor Vibration

Rotor unbalance produces synchronous vibration at running speed.

Near critical speed, rotor response is amplified and phase changes rapidly.

Condition monitoring should track amplitude, phase, and orbit shape together.
